e.body: XihongActuary/alm-kb（「执两用中 · 精算师手记系列」，静态站点，2026-08-22）是**保险公司资产负债管理（ALM）的中文长文知识库**：正文 13 篇独立长文，每篇 27–82KB——序章、执两、时间、利率、现金、变局、瘦身、守底、双向、利器、筑基、终章，外加一篇《正式版新规解读》；结构化模块 10 个，覆盖 foundations（基础）、framework（框架）、regulation（监管）、calculations（计算）、practice（实务）、resources（资源），并单列 regulation-draft / regulation-final / rule4 / rule5 四份规则文本。对 RIAA：ALM 是寿险经营与精算的核心交叉领域，而**中文体系化的 ALM 材料相对稀缺**——这份知识库把久期/凸性/免疫（[[duration]]、[[convexity]]、[[immunization]]）、收益率曲线（[[yield-curve]]）与保险公司负债特性、监管资本约束串在一起讲；可与 [[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]]（EAA 的 ALM+AI 讲座）、[[solvency2rfr]]（EIOPA 无风险利率期限结构）、[[qarm]]（Solvency II 组合优化）、[[open-source-economic-model]]（开源经济情景生成）互为中英/理论实务的对照；适合作 ALM、投资风险与偿付能力方向的入门到进阶阅读。注意：仓库未声明许可证，站点为静态 HTML；与同作者的 [[product-actuary-kb]] 同属「精算师手记系列」。
e.body_en: XihongActuary/alm-kb ("holding both ends", the Actuary’s Notes series; a static site, 2026-08-22) is a **Chinese-language long-form knowledge base on insurer asset-liability management (ALM)**: 13 standalone essays of 27–82KB each (preface, dual balance, time, interest rates, cash, regime change, slimming, defending the floor, two-way, toolkit, foundations, finale) plus an interpretation of the final version of the new rules; 10 structured modules cover foundations, framework, regulation, calculations, practice and resources, with regulation-draft / regulation-final / rule4 / rule5 texts broken out. For RIAA: ALM sits at the core intersection of life insurance management and actuarial work, yet **systematic Chinese-language ALM material is relatively scarce** — this knowledge base ties duration/convexity/immunisation ([[duration]], [[convexity]], [[immunization]]) and the yield curve ([[yield-curve]]) to insurer liability characteristics and regulatory capital constraints; read it against [[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]] (the EAA ALM + AI session), [[solvency2rfr]] (EIOPA risk-free rate term structures), [[qarm]] (Solvency II portfolio optimisation) and [[open-source-economic-model]] (open-source ESG) for a Chinese-vs-English, theory-vs-practice contrast; suited to introductory through advanced reading in ALM, investment risk and solvency. Note: no licence declared, static HTML; shares the "Actuary’s Notes" series with the same author’s [[product-actuary-kb]].
e.body_hk: XihongActuary/alm-kb（「執兩用中 · 精算師手記系列」，靜態站點，2026-08-22）是**保險公司資產負債管理（ALM）的中文長文知識庫**：正文 13 篇獨立長文，每篇 27–82KB——序章、執兩、時間、利率、現金、變局、瘦身、守底、雙向、利器、築基、終章，外加一篇《正式版新規解讀》；結構化模組 10 個，覆蓋 foundations、framework、regulation、calculations、practice、resources，並單列 regulation-draft / regulation-final / rule4 / rule5。對 RIAA：ALM 是壽險經營與精算的核心交叉領域，而**中文體系化的 ALM 材料相對稀缺**——這份知識庫把久期/凸性/免疫（[[duration]]、[[convexity]]、[[immunization]]）、收益率曲線（[[yield-curve]]）與保險公司負債特性、監管資本約束串在一起講；可與 [[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]]、[[solvency2rfr]]、[[qarm]]、[[open-source-economic-model]] 互為中英/理論實務的對照；適合作 ALM、投資風險與償付能力方向的閱讀。注意：倉庫未聲明許可證，站點為靜態 HTML；與同作者的 [[product-actuary-kb]] 同屬「精算師手記系列」。
